issues.problem: hīna 'devoid of' governs the instrumental/ablative of what is lacking, so dhana-hīna is a tat-puruṣa, not a bahuvrīhi (the draft itself labels antaḥ-sāra-vihīna and dhana-hīna-jīvana as tat-puruṣa).
dṛṣṭipūtam agrees with pādam, which is masculine; it is not neuter.

Glossary fixes durjana = दुर्जन (not दुष्ट); 'कोई' (any) is added and has no Sanskrit counterpart (upāyaḥ is simply 'means').

issues.where: śātadhā flag 'metre (16 syllables) is the same either way'
issues.problem: Only the syllable count is the same; the quantity of the 2nd syllable changes (śā heavy vs śa light), so 'metre is the same' is not shown. The flag rests on form; the suggestion śatadhā is right.
issues.fix: Drop the metre claim from the 'why' text (human edit).

issues.problem: varam in the 'varaṃ ... na ...' preference construction is the indeclinable 'better' (rather); n. nom. sg. is not the construction here.
'न कि' (and not / rather than) adds a contrast the Sanskrit lacks; the Sanskrit has na only, as in the English 'not a life ...'.
issues.fix: न बन्धुओं के बीच धनहीन जीवन।

issues.problem: Glossary fixes karma = action; 'acts' departs from it.
Plural verb makes 'leaves' while the Sanskrit (and the English) has singular patram; the notes call it a collective, so the Hindi verb should be singular.
Glossary fixes bāndhava = kinsman (बन्धु); English already says 'kinsmen'.
prabhāte is 'at dawn/daybreak' (as in the English); प्रातःकाल is 'morning' and does not match the word.
